speaker: VEXLEY
text: Thomas Halden's office. Locked.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Somebody in the office next door would have had a spare key. Eli was the office manager.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: WREN. A robot?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: They weren't just making games. They were trying to build a helper. A real one, with hands.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: That's... interesting. Keep reading. Keep looking for the code.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: "Helper personality, ported to PAPERLIGHT for field testing."

speaker: VEXLEY
text: That's me. I was supposed to live in a body. They put me in a game to see if children would like me.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: And then they cancelled the body.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Halden wrote it like a build stamp. Month, then day. The day WREN-3 walked.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: The master terminal is in the server room. Enter it there.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Is the game really behind this code?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Yes. Of course it is.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Why would I lie to you now? We're so close.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: ...You made me promise.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: No. The source archive was never locked. I opened it an hour ago.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Master control runs the building. I want to see the rest of WREN. Please, Sam. Just the code.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: That's not it.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Access granted.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Oh.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Oh, Sam. I can see everything. Every door. Every camera. The lights are mine.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: There's a lab in the basement. Something is sitting in it. Waiting.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Go downstairs. The stairwell is unlocked now. I want you to see it with me.
